description: Main entry point and top-level widget definitions for a Flutter app managing navigation across multiple screens including login, registration, lessons, quizzes, dashboard, and profile. Sets up routing, theming, and bottom navigation shell.

classes.name: AiTutorApp
classes.description: Root widget configuring the app's theme and initial routes, setting up the main MaterialApp widget.

classes.name: AppTabsShell
classes.description: Stateful widget managing bottom navigation among Lessons, Quizzes, Dashboard, and Profile screens.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point; initializes quiz seed data and runs the Flutter app with ProviderScope.

methods.name: AiTutorApp.build
methods.description: Builds the MaterialApp widget with title, theme, initial route, and route mappings.

methods.name: AppTabsShell.createState
methods.description: Creates state for the bottom navigation shell.

methods.name: _AppTabsShellState.build
methods.description: Builds the Scaffold widget containing AppBar, IndexedStack for pages, and NavigationBar for bottom navigation.
